found_by: A development agent repairing the invitation command read the account email probe record and noticed that the identity provider still allows anyone to register.

exposure.statement_we_published: The service reported registration_available false and the site offered no sign-up form.
exposure.what_was_actually_possible: Browser sign-in was switched on with account creation allowed. The identity provider's public settings allow self-registration, and the project address and publishable key are served publicly, as they must be for a browser to sign in. A stranger could therefore register at the provider, confirm the address and then ask this service to create an account.
exposure.what_they_would_have_received: An account with no grants and metadata-only entitlement, so no item is visible and no body can be read. They could create personal client keys within the per-account limits.
exposure.severity: low in effect, but the published statement was not true, and it is a resource consumption path
exposure.exploited: No. The account listing at the identity provider holds the same two accounts as before, and no tenant was created.

attempted_fix_at_the_provider.action: Read the provider's authentication settings with the management credential, intending to close self-registration there.
attempted_fix_at_the_provider.result: 403, the grant is missing the authentication settings scope. This is the permission gap already recorded in the takeover checkpoint.
attempted_fix_at_the_provider.conclusion: The provider cannot be changed with the access engineering holds, so the fix had to be on our side.

fix.change: registration_enabled set to false in the browser identity block of the host configuration.
fix.effect: A subject the operator has already bound can still sign in and use personal client keys. Creating a new account is refused, so the published statement is now true.
fix.not_changed: Browser sign-in and personal client keys stay installed and available. The image is unchanged.
procedure: The configuration was backed up to /data/host.json.backup-before-closing-registration on the volume.
The new configuration was loaded with the real loader inside the running machine before anything was replaced.
Only then was it moved into place, and the machine restarted rather than redeployed, because no secret changed.

when_this_reverses: Account creation is switched on again with the account email work, which brings its own sign-up journey and a request limit for each address and each email address. Open registration is the intended product behaviour at that point, and the control then is payment and entitlement rather than a closed door.
related_open_finding: The website still has no view for setting a password from an invitation link, so an invitation cannot be delivered to a person yet. That is owned by the account views work.
